headline: Quick, non-professional test—reference only: local Laya on RX 6800 XT vs Jev API.
text:
Quick, non-professional test—reference only: local Laya on RX 6800 XT vs Jev API.
• Single-query latency: 20 vs 262 ms
• Chinese classification: 61.7% vs 82.8%
• Chinese NLI: 72.2% vs 74.0%
1,140 public test examples. Local vs remote latency; no overall winner claim.
